author: Cleo Abram
description:
Earth is eating its own history… 

There’s a big mystery about one of the most important processes on Earth: plate tectonics. That’s the way our planet’s hard upper shell moves, shaping the surface. Scientists think this process is vital for recycling materials and ultimately keeping the Earth habitable for billions of years. The trouble is… we don’t know how it started, but a planetary neighbor MIGHT hold the secrets.

To find out more, subscribe!

title: Earth Is Eating Its Own History
